_comment: Measured ablation budgets for the nRF52840 usb_ethernet firmware.
Produced by sweep.py / combined.py / ceiling.py against work/modified with
xarxa at the flux-specs-slice-index base. The reference .text reproduced
exactly on the determinism check (136620 twice), so these deltas are not
Ablation is get_unchecked with NO proof: it is the CEILING for a piece of
work, not a forecast. A site only leaves the real binary once its obligation
is actually discharged and check_proof.py passes.

ceiling_all_xarxa._what: every ablatable xarxa panic removed at once; 33 of 35 files
ceiling_all_xarxa._excluded_why: ablator cannot rewrite them: [u8; N] has no __ai impl, and assembler.rs hits borrowck

churn_batch_8_files._what: only the CHURN lines in the 8 candidate files, ablated together

per_file_churn_only._what: each file's CHURN lines ablated ALONE. These DO NOT SUM: they total
per_file_churn_only._what2: -1904 B while the same eight together give -2500 B. Superadditive,
per_file_churn_only._what3: because shared panic machinery only dies when its last user does.

noise_floor._what: a rebuild of identical sources reproduced .text exactly, so there is
noise_floor._what2: no link noise. But a real source change shifts inlining: the largest
noise_floor._what3: INCREASE observed was +84 B here, +332 B in the historical whole-file
noise_floor._what4: sweep. Treat a single-file delta under ~300 B as unresolved.
